principles.causality: Strictly chronological, zero lookahead bias, no future bar peeking
principles.retention_gate: N_alert_new >= N_alert_baseline and N_fill_new >= N_fill_baseline (100% retention minimum)
principles.honesty: If economic criteria are not met, report clear failure with reproducible ledgers

B0.name: B0_LITERAL
B0.description: Literal MT5 baseline replicating original v3.01 quirks, float precision truncations (rr1 < 1.5), transient zone indices, and plan coupling

B1.name: B1_TECHNICAL
B1.description: Surgical technical bugfixes: float precision tolerance 1e-7, decoupled candidate detection from plan active lifecycle, deterministic zone keys

H1.name: H1_ROOM_NET_R
H1.description: Priority ranking among multiple candidate zones on the same confirmation candle by room_net_R = (opposing_room - roundtrip_cost) / R_price
H1.guardrail: candidate_sl_dist <= baseline_sl_dist + 1e-9 (structural stop cannot be wider than baseline)
tie_breakers: smaller distance from entry to originating zone edge
H1.unknown_opposing_room_handling: ranked after candidates with measured opposing room; never assigned infinity; retains baseline order if all unknown

H2.name: H2_RETEST_LIMIT
H2.description: Virtual limit order placed at known CHoCH level at t0 with 5-minute (M5 bar) retest window and market fallback
H2.limit_fill_rule: BUY fills when Ask <= limit; SELL fills when Bid >= limit; fill at exact limit price without favorable slip
cancellation_conditions: SL level touched before limit fill
Baseline TP level touched before limit fill

market_fallback.execution: First available quote at or after deadline if setup remains valid; quote delay > 60s marked execution failure

H2.intrabar_processing: Strict chronological sequence across M1 quotes; no future peeking

H1_H2.name: H1_H2_COMBINED
H1_H2.description: Exploratory combined branch applying H1 zone selection and H2 5-minute limit entry

primary.description: Clean 1:1 risk-reward target with strict 120-minute timeout from t0 for all branches

secondary.description: Sensitivity diagnostic testing lower target threshold

portfolio_execution.rule: strictly 1 open position forward in time; signals occurring while a position is open are excluded from portfolio execution

telemetry_specifications.metric_1: Exact originating H1 zone (ID, coordinates, type, score)
telemetry_specifications.metric_2: Distance to zone in price and normalized by ATR (dist / atr)
telemetry_specifications.metric_3: Opposing barrier room and room_net_R = (room - cost) / risk
telemetry_specifications.metric_4: Current spread vs SL distance ratio (spread / risk)
telemetry_specifications.metric_5: CHoCH execution latency (slippage from bar close to current price)
telemetry_specifications.guard: Telemetry metrics are strictly informational for manual decision support; zero automated trade filtering or uncalibrated win probabilities

trade_retention.annual_gate: N_alert_new >= N_alert_baseline and N_fill_new >= N_fill_baseline for each year 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025

economic_viability.max_drawdown: <= baseline drawdown under identical risk sizing

acceptance_criteria.stopping_rule: If no candidate satisfies both retention and economic edge under fees, report definitive failure with full ledgers and audit trails
